annotations.title: Get Item Details and Reported Trades

description:
Read Jagex catalogue records and guide prices by GE item ID or resolved name. Use lookup_item for ID discovery, compare_item_prices for daily comparisons, or get_price_series for raw history.

itemId bypasses name resolution; name resolves first and errors with candidates on ambiguity. Both return item. itemIds uses known GE IDs, preserves input order and always returns results[], even for one ID. Wiki monster IDs are a different identifier system.

Use includeLiveData for recorded instant-buy/instant-sell prices and buy-limit/alchemy facts. It preserves guide fields; trades are not executable offers, and buy limits are not remaining quota.

Invalid batches fail before fetching. Unavailable IDs fail per row; all-failed batches error. At most two reads run concurrently; 429 halts queued IDs.

Cache/freshness:
- Guide records are uncached and lag market activity.
- Trades cache 30 seconds; numeric facts cache 10 minutes.
- Cache hits keep their fetchedAt timestamp.

No credentials required. HTTP defaults to 60 requests/IP/minute; honor 429 Retry-After.

includeLiveData.description: Add RS3 API v2 last-reported trade high/low prices and numeric buy-limit/alchemy facts; preserves Jagex guide-price fields

itemId.description: Grand Exchange item ID (provide itemId or name)

itemIds.description: Known GE IDs for a catalogue metadata batch; exclusive with itemId/name

name.description: Item name (provide itemId or name). Prefer lookup_item for fuzzy search.

item.description: Jagex catalogue item detail; prices are guide values, not executable offers

price.description: Coins, possibly abbreviated with k or m

liveTrades.description: Opt-in RS3 recorded transactions; no order book or guaranteed fill price

fetchedAt.description: Snapshot retrieval time; retained on cache hits

high.description: Last reported instant-buy price in coins; may exceed 32-bit integers; null means none reported

highTime.description: Instant-buy transaction Unix timestamp in seconds

low.description: Last reported instant-sell price in coins; null means none reported

lowTime.description: Instant-sell transaction Unix timestamp in seconds

members.description: Whether the item requires membership; Jagex returns a string

wikiFacts.description: Opt-in numeric mapping fields; null when no usable mapping exists

buyLimit.description: Published GE buy-limit cap, not remaining account quota

fetchedAt.description: Mapping retrieval time; retained on cache hits

wikiUrl.description: Wiki item-ID lookup link; redirects to the corresponding article without a title search
